title: U-Mamba: Enhancing Long-range Dependency for Biomedical Image Segmentation
mechanism: Hybrid CNN-SSM block: conv residual block followed by a Mamba layer over flattened feature maps, in the encoder or the bottleneck only, inside nnU-Net.
adaptation: Suite member: U-Mamba_Bot 2D at 512 px, same folds and label-safe aug; needs mamba-ssm CUDA kernels (install requires OK). Always paired with the No-Mamba ablation, as Revisited did.
min_experiment: U-Mamba_Bot v No-Mamba base, 5 folds each. Kill (for score purposes) if E1 relF1@2 difference < 0.03; keep as benchmark row regardless.
evidence: R: beats CNN and Transformer baselines on 3D CT/MR, 2D endoscopy, 2D microscopy. Counter-evidence: nnU-Net Revisited finds Mamba layers have no effect against a No-Mamba residual U-Net.
